name: Absolute Zero
primary:
Everything within five blocks freezes solid and stops moving.
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 9-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 5.75 ❤ cold
• Cold 240: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness V for 16 s
• Rooted in place for 10 s
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 16 s
self_description:
On you:
• Stone skin (Resistance III) for 15 s
• Cold 60: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
